select_api_model_library: select the AlphaZero model library API version between nnx and linen implementations
convert_linen_to_nnx_model: convert a Flax linen model to an NNX model for inference with a given random seed
convert_nnx_to_linen_model: convert an NNX model class to a Flax linen model with sample shape and seed
create_train_input_dataclass: create a frozen TrainInput dataclass holding observation, legals_mask, policy, and value arrays
compute_total_loss: compute the total loss from policy, value, and L2 components with addition and division support
